business_value: An ordered array of fragments concatenated into one field value. Construct the value to fulfil its assigned field purpose, preserving source-backed conditions and obligations. Surrounding text supplies any explanation or behavioral meaning the field requires.
exact_copy: When reproducing a supplied preserved_tokens literal, insert an exact_copy object instead of typing the literal inside a string. Put any surrounding prose in separate string fragments. Include claim_id only when the selected schema requires it.
references: Reference objects insert supplied display values; they do not explain their use or authorize operations.
sources: Original sources establish meaning; code samples remain context. Supplied groups expose complete retained requirements. When the schema requests signal_ids, select only groups that support the value's assigned purpose; several groups may jointly support it. Availability is not support. A record's requirements are fixed by its one assigned group. Do not invent decisions.
clarification: A missing user decision: state known facts, the choice, its impact and the expected answer. Missing prewritten sections are not user decisions.
inconclusive: Unresolved interpretation of the supplied evidence.
